acceptance_rule: Accept only if: (1) at least two independent earnings seasons of PIT eps_estimate_delta_30d data are available with >=20 usable core candidates per season, (2) the 10d horizon bucket test shows positive average PnL lift in >= 2/3 canonical windows after de-duplicating by ticker, (3) concentration passes (single-ticker positive share <= 50%, top-5 <= 60%), and (4) average PnL lift >= $500 and average return lift >= 5pp across the qualifying sample. A retry on the current single-season sample does not satisfy condition (1).

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Create the ticket under registry lock before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: PIT estimate-revision data shows a consistent 5d-negative / 10d-positive signature across three sub-hypotheses (residual-PEAD, tier-stratified PEAD window, revision-magnitude). The 5d horizon was cleanly disproven in exp-20260528-027/028 and exp-20260529-007. The 10d flip is directionally promising but the current single earnings-season sample (exp-20260527-908: 85.1% PIT coverage; exp-20260528-030: 80.85%) is insufficient for Gate 4 promotion. This ticket pre-registers the 10d test and its acceptance criteria so that when the second earnings season accumulates, the experiment can run immediately without designing acceptance criteria after seeing data.

prediction.confidence_reason: 5d was cleanly disproven across 3 sub-hypotheses but all showed 5d-negative/10d-positive signature. If the 10d flip is real and not noise, a second earnings season should reproduce it. Prior probability is tempered by the fact that single-season evidence could be noise.

repro_command: Register this experiment ID now; run the actual backtest only after two independent earnings seasons of PIT eps_estimate_delta_30d data exist with >=20 usable candidates per season.
summary: Pre-registration of the PEAD 10d horizon experiment. The 5d horizon is frozen as disproven. The 10d flip is directionally interesting but cannot be tested credibly on a single earnings season. This ticket reserves the ID, defines acceptance criteria, and blocks premature retry until multi-season data accumulates.

evaluation_windows.description: Multi-season: requires >=2 independent earnings seasons of PIT data
evaluation_windows.note: Do not run this experiment on the current single-season sample. Wait until the second earnings season has accumulated eps_estimate_delta_30d data with PIT coverage >= 80%.

blocking_conditions: Only one earnings season of PIT eps_estimate_delta_30d data currently exists (coverage ~80-85% per exp-20260527-908 and exp-20260528-030)
All three 5d sub-hypotheses were rejected (exp-20260528-027: residual PEAD -3.60pp; exp-20260528-028: tier-stratified PEAD -0.40pp; exp-20260529-007: revision magnitude -1.15pp)
10d buckets in current sample are below the published closed-outcome floors
Do NOT run: VWAP reclaim, long-base, or any outside-PEAD short-horizon retry on this direction until this ticket's blocking conditions clear
